description: Get the user's LinkedIn social activity: connections, posts, articles, comments, likes, job applications, saved jobs, and job-search preferences. Use for questions about their network, content, or job search. Prefer specific sections — these can be large.

domains.description: Sections to include. CONNECTIONS (network), MEMBER_SHARE_INFO (posts), ARTICLES (published articles), ALL_COMMENTS, ALL_LIKES, JOB_APPLICATIONS, JOB_POSTINGS (jobs they posted), SAVED_JOBS, JOB_SEEKER_PREFERENCES.

maxPagesPerDomain.description: Max pages of results to fetch (1–25). Each page holds ~10 records. Lower this to keep responses small.

name: linkedin_get_activity

apiVersion.description: LinkedIn API version used for the request.

domains.description: Records grouped by section name (e.g. POSITIONS, EDUCATION). Each value is the list of items in that section.

metadata.description: Per-section fetch stats. Check truncated to detect partial results.

truncated.description: True if more results exist beyond the page limit.

title: Get LinkedIn activity
